interpretation: These are source-attributed first boundaries, not observed exception records or a new qualification campaign.

Each prospective operational fault requires separate genuine external root fault authorization, a fresh process, and the complete launch/collection contract. No fault card is an actual acceptance or history.
Every prior guard must be satisfied with exact unchanged sealed sources unless the row explicitly targets an earlier guard. An earlier error gives no credit for the named later boundary.
Refused has no numeric code. Do not import a policy Stop.code into dispatcher evidence.
An expected policy RETURN or REFUSED inside a successful 139-case observation is not an outer dispatcher refusal.

Failures inside execute_one normally produce the complete envelope on stderr with exit 2. main arity and errors escaping envelope serialization/write instead use the terminal text prefix RI136 QUALIFICATION REFUSAL: and genuine exit 2. External capture/completion remains required in both cases.

lifecycle_and_collection_failures.condition: An actual handled SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP or SIGALRM occurs.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.semantics: Before finalization inside execute_one, first_error may be Refused with qualification interrupted by signal <integer>. During finalization the handler records the signal without replacing first_error; received_signals invalidates success. A signal before execute_one or after envelope serialization has different capture visibility; reconcile actual timing and genuine exit, never invent a uniform envelope.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.credit: Genuine lifecycle evidence only, not a policy refusal. No delayed fixture, stop handshake or source patch is specified.

lifecycle_and_collection_failures.location: execute_one / resource guard and final elapsed check
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.condition: Real self RSS exceeds 536870912 bytes after the policy result, or elapsed_ns exceeds 120000000000.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.semantics: The reached RSS guard raises Refused with self RSS ceiling exceeded. The final elapsed condition can yield stderr/exit 2 with first_error null; do not invent an elapsed exception message. External owned-group/resource obligations remain independent and may fail or terminate earlier.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.credit: Actual resource/elapsed observation only; an external earlier limit failure does not demonstrate this in-process guard.

lifecycle_and_collection_failures.condition: Any actual registered-file postcheck fails, capture/write breaks, output exceeds its bound, external monitor/census fails, no live leader is sampled, or owned processes remain.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.semantics: Every registered path is attempted independently and unchanged false/errors remain beside the original first_error. Output serialization cap raises qualification output exceeds fixed cap outside the normal envelope; write/flush failures may likewise escape to terminal refusal text or partial capture. External failures may leave a syntactically successful inner result, which is still not accepted.
lifecycle_and_collection_failures.credit: Custody/completion failure only. Root performs full independent 373-dependency/runtime/namespace postchecks even when the in-process registered-file set is partial; never replace failures with fabricated success or retry evidence.
